subject: general
question: NITI is abbreviation for_________.
solution:
The correct answer is the __National Institution for Transforming India__.

__
 
• The full form of NITI Ayog is the National Institution for Transforming India.​__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **NITI Aayog:**

 
 
• NITI Aayog or **National Institution for Transforming India **Aayog is the replacement of the Planning Commission of India.
 
• National Institution for Transforming India (NITI) Aayog was created in accordance with the announcement made by Prime Minister, Narendra Modi on **15 August 2014.**
 
• The Government of India, in keeping with its reform agenda, constituted the** NITI Aayog to replace the Planning Commission instituted in 1950.**
 
• The Planning Commission was replaced by a new institution – **NITI AAYOG (National Institution for Transforming India) on January 1, 2015.**
 
 
• It focuses upon the ‘Bottom-Up’ approach to Planning.
 
 
 
• **Administrative Skeltal**:
 
 
• **Vice-Chairman - Dr. Suman Bery**
 
• **CEO - Parameswaran Iyer**
 
• **Chairperson: Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
